formula.affine_form: x = x0 + sum_i a_i * eps_i + r, |eps_i| <= 1, |r_j| <= rho_j

soundness_note: The bound follows from triangle/reverse-triangle inequalities and ||P r||_2 <= ||r||_2 <= ||rho||_2. It preserves generator-wise vector correlation lost by independent componentwise square intervals.
diagnostic_comparison: existing componentwise LayerNorm variance lower bound
claim_boundary: Diagnostic/tightness candidate only. It is not automatically sharper on every box, does not provide directed-rounding rigor, and does not authorize X7 or shipping.
execution_order: Run the frozen learned-field R512 primary fidelity gate first; only then spend effort on certification-tightness engineering.
